Excited to share that I have successfully participated in the National Data Science Olympiad 2026, organized by SRM Institute of Science and Technology (SRMIST), Chennai, under the Pinnacle Excellence Conclave 2026.
Although my academic background is in BA LLB, I strongly believe that learning beyond one's core discipline helps develop analytical thinking and problem-solving skills. Participating in this Olympiad allowed me to explore the fundamentals of data science and broaden my perspective.
I look forward to continuing my journey of learning and exploring interdisciplinary opportunities.
